notes: §1985:XIV.2.2.4 GR27: data-name-2 "has the format 'HHMMSSTT'" for the time the MCS recognized the message complete, updated "only by the MCS as part of the execution of the RECEIVE statement". StoredMessage#Complete renders HHmmss plus milliseconds/10 at completion; MessageControlSession#Transfer stores it at positions 7-14 through CommunicationArea#SetReceived on a transferring RECEIVE only, and other statements touch only the status key (#Statement). Probes at --std 85: a message an output CD SENDs (deliverTo terminal) is received with a time between CURRENT-DATE before and after the SEND, a seeded time is in HHMMSSTT form, an ODO receiving item, NO DATA and a refused RECEIVE leave the moved time; the witness covers SEND/PURGE/DISABLE/ENABLE.

next.reason: 1985: "Data-name-2 has the format 'HHMMSSTT' ... the time at which the MCS recognizes that the message is complete"; 2023: "No 2023 clause holds the communication description entry; the CD message-time field is absent". No 2023 clause carries the CD entry. The RECEIVE CONTINUE rule and the ACCEPT TIME rule are different subjects and state no MCS message-completion time field.
